column1: # The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2, update v131072 over the base). Profile from the first .nup probe (scripts/nup_probe.py); in bring-up
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive, Havok, CRIWARE), SDK 22.2.8 built for the Switch 2, NVN2; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK movie 22.2.8) + sdk.
# The dump is a .nup (android/NUP.md) whose update package (0400486024DEC800, v131072) carries the whole game; main.npdm's program ID is the base's.
name    The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
# v131072 is the update's title version; a .nup carries no control data to name a display version
build   v131072 v131072 main=e0f3ccfaf50065ae4ea01eb5aeb13b1a   subsdk0=b0110087a7b339ef74588d3bd0b4dd5d        sdk=1643a838814f9c10c696f930ed681e7f
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (rtld is not listed, as on the other profiles; the survey's "what" column says what each is)
# unconfirmed: the probe's RomFS listing holds the 20 largest top folders (TerrainArc/..., Tex, Model, ...) and System/ is not one of them; the Android flow does not read it
# the engine family's set, as Donkey Kong Bananza and Mario Kart World; the probe reads no file headers, so unmeasured until the first pack
# The NPDM declares 48 MB of system resource (virtual address memory on, as Mario Kart World's 64 MB): nninitStartup sets the heap to the free application memory less a fixed
# reserve. The rows below are Mario Kart World's map (the same engine and path), not measured on this game - the heap request and the alias fills are the bring-up's to read
# from the phone's log: 256 MB stack region, a 4 GB alias region, the 9 GB pool the Switch 2 leaves games (as Donkey Kong Bananza)
# measured by the phone split (the Prepare job, 2026-11-07): it cut ps/vs/cs_effect.bin (from /Effect/), ps/vs/cs_shader.bin (from /Shader/) and ps/vs/cs/ts/ms_other.bin
# (the rest: /Lib/, /Layout2Shader/, main); no /UI/ sources exist, so the UI group yields nothing (kept, as the family's row)
shader_note     The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time shaders
